description: This file defines the NoteListViewModel class, which is an Android ViewModel responsible for managing and providing data related to note categories and counts for a note-taking app. It interacts with a NotesRepository to fetch data and transforms it into a format suitable for UI components, specifically navigation categories.

classes.name: NoteListViewModel
classes.description: An Android ViewModel that provides navigation categories and counts for the notes app, transforming data from the repository into UI-ready navigation items.

methods.name: NoteListViewModel
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the ViewModel with the application context and obtains an instance of NotesRepository.

methods.name: getAdapterCategories
methods.description: Returns a LiveData list of NavigationItem objects representing different categories (Recent, Favorites, and user-defined categories) for a given account ID, with data transformations and filtering applied.
